mentions.note: Giso was reading a book with a black cover. It had the difficult title The Blue Cliff Record. "Even we read the Blue Cliff Record, but beyond our own level we have no idea what it means."*

mentions.author: Tōrei Enji
mentions.note: Giso took the usual book from his bosom and set it before Sosuke. It was a book called the Shūmon mujintō ron. "It is a wonderful book," he had told Sosuke.*

mentions.author: Shen Deqian
mentions.note: Yoshio took the Chinese-bound book in its case from Nobu and stared for a long time at the weighty title written on it, Mingshi biecai ji.*

mentions.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
mentions.note: "This is Nietzsche, the poet of Thus Spoke Zarathustra. That saint sought salvation in the Superman he himself had created. But he was not saved after all, and went mad."*

mentions.author: Dante Alighieri
mentions.note: I remembered the souls turned into trees in Dante's Inferno, and decided to walk on the far side of the tram tracks, where there was nothing but rows of buildings.*

mentions.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
mentions.note: To dispel this fear I began to read Crime and Punishment. But the page I happened to open was a passage from The Brothers Karamazov, and I thought I had picked up the wrong book.*

mentions.author: Leo Tolstoy
mentions.note: I lay down on the bed and began to read Tolstoy's Polikouchka. Its hero was a man of complex character, a mixture of vanity, morbid tendencies and ambition.*

mentions.author: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa
mentions.note: "You don't seem to write at all. Though I did read 'Tenkibo'... Is that your autobiography?" "Yes, it's my autobiography."*

mentions.author: August Strindberg
mentions.note: On the second floor of Maruzen I found Strindberg's Legend on a shelf and read a few pages here and there. It described experiences not much different from my own.*

mentions.author: Naoya Shiga
mentions.note: After he had finally left, I lay on the bed and began to read A Dark Night's Passing. The hero's spiritual struggles were painfully real to me.*

mentions.author: Mokichi Saito
mentions.note: "I'm sending you the reprint of the poetry collection Shakko..." Shakko! I felt some unseen thing sneering at me, and decided to flee from my room.*

mentions.author: Natsume Soseki
mentions.note: I picked Soseki's I Am a Cat from the bookshelf and gave it to her.*

mentions.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
mentions.note: Crime and Punishment. Dostoevsky. It grazed a corner of my mind, and I gasped: what if Dostoevsky had not treated crime and punishment as synonyms, but set them side by side as antonyms?*

mentions.author: Ivan Turgenev
mentions.note: "What about Turgenev?" "He's an aristocrat. That's why I dislike him." "But A Sportsman's Sketches..." "Yes, that one is rather good, I admit."*

mentions.author: Rosa Luxemburg
mentions.note: In the room next to the parlor, I was reading Rosa Luxemburg's Introduction to Political Economy with a strange excitement. I had brought it from Naoji's room upstairs the other day.*
Once I found a Chinese-edition Jin Ping Mei at a secondhand bookstall and asked the owner the price. He said seven yen.*
What he was reading these days was the Mikawa Gofudoki. It had a great many volumes, so he said it would keep him amused for some time.*

mentions.mentioned: The Words of the Orange Seller
mentions.author: Liu Ji
mentions.note: The phrase "strikes the nose" from The Words of the Orange Seller, which I had learned in classical Chinese class, floated up in fragments.*

mentions.author: Vasubandhu
mentions.note: …but in the Hokke Scripture I have not got to the Law-Master Chapter, and in the Gusha-shastra I have not got as far as the Seventh Book.

mentions.author: James Sully
mentions.note: “Speaking of ‘illusions,’ of all the books I’ve read so far, none has seemed as fascinating to me as Sully’s ‘Illusions.’ I read it straight through in two days and a night.”*

mentions.author: Natsume Sōseki
mentions.note: Natsume Sōseki, in Pillow of Grass, praises the color of the confection yōkan; and is it not indeed a color to call forth meditation?
